description: Version of the gate verdict the gate produces (GX-10, GA-P01). 4 adds the proof binding (head/base trees, gate_version, toolchain_id, selection, input_digest, cost, lane_id) when the run is fully bound (a sha, a recorded base and a tier); a run that is not keeps v3. 3 is the rollback: today's v3 payload, byte for byte.
